title: Plane and spherical wavefronts
back: Wavefront = points in the same phase; rays are perpendicular to it. Point source: spherical; distant source: plane.

title: Huygens construction for refraction
back: BC = v₁τ = AC sin i; AE = v₂τ = AC sin r; so sin i/sin r = v₁/v₂.

title: Young's double-slit set-up
back: Two coherent slits d apart, screen at D: bright fringes at nλD/d; fringe width λD/d.

title: Double slit vs single slit pattern
back: Interference: equal fringes, equal brightness. Diffraction: central maximum twice as wide, fainter sides.

title: Snell’s law from wave theory
legend: v₁, v₂ = speeds in the two media
back: Shows light is slower in the denser medium; frequency stays the same.

title: Path difference and phase difference
back: Coherent sources keep φ constant in time.

title: YDSE fringe width
back: Final expression only for boards. In a medium: β/n.

title: Single slit: central maximum
legend: θ = minima where a sin θ = nλ
back: A narrower slit gives a wider central maximum.

title: Interference or diffraction?
back: Interference: two coherent sources. Diffraction: one wavefront bending round a slit.
